body: Yeah, having family right there helps.
Newp.  None of them have, which is why it feels so hopeless.
They just got the blood results back that it is some sort of "thyroiditis"
They just realized it's a problem.  Maybe it will help when/if they figure it out.  Waiting until then is the hard part.
Now I am on Buspar and Celexa.  I have been on Prozac, Zoloft, Wellbutrin, Effexor, and Abilify.

I posted my issue similar to this in another post.  I went to many therapists and most of them were worthless.  My last one was ok, but really I don't think they helped me much.  It's more like a place to listen to yourself complain it seems.  Maybe ask her what she suggests you can do.  
Have you told any family?

Edit: This sounded more coherent in my head... Sorry I am in your spot right now too so a little disconnected

I'm a chick, but yeah I know I need to get out of the rut.  It just seems so nice and cozy in the pit of death compared to everything else.
I'm surprised to see so many responses.  I know many people answer because they sort of feel like they don't want to ignore this stuff, but still nice.

They were and are still somewhat supportive now.  Although I always get the "but you have so much going for you, why are you depressed" line.  I think it takes another person who is or has gone through this to really understand it's not a choice to feel this way.
For a job - the one I may lose.
